@graph.name: Mole Removal
@graph.description: Visit Derma Solutions for the Best Mole Removal Treatment in Bangalore. Safe, Affordable, and Advanced Laser treatments. Book Your Appointment Today!
@graph.howPerformed: Small moles are usually treated with radiofrequency ablation (RFN) or CO2 laser, while larger moles are removed with cosmetic surgical excision. Afterwards, keep the treated area clean and dry, apply the prescribed ointments, avoid direct sun and use sunscreen. Healing typically takes 1–2 weeks after RFN or laser.

acceptedAnswer.text: The procedure is done under local anesthesia, so discomfort is minimal.
RFN and CO2 laser help minimize scarring, and surgical excision uses cosmetic techniques for the best possible result. Healing varies from person to person.
Most moles can be removed, but the method depends on their size, type and location. A consultation determines the best approach.

mainEntity.name: How soon will the treated area heal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Healing typically takes 1–2 weeks after RFN or laser treatment, while surgical excisions may take slightly longer.
